title: Devastator: The Capture Above Tatooine
description: A vast Imperial wedge hangs above a desert planetary limb. Beneath its illuminated ventral hangar, a tiny red-and-white Tantive IV is being hauled aboard. Layered armored decks, a panoramic command bridge, twin shield generators, eight heavy turbolasers and three main plus four auxiliary engines complete the silhouette.

sections.name: Connected orbital display, planetary limb and concealed cradles
Interlocked triangular keel, beveled rim and shallow armored facets
Recessed service galleries, cooling combs and dorsal conduits
Three main drives and four auxiliary thrusters
Ventral docking aperture and tractor emitters
